items.title: MathNet: a Global Multimodal Benchmark for Mathematical Reasoning and Retrieval
items.title_zh: MathNet：面向数学推理与检索的全球多模态基准
items.summary: MathNet is a multilingual, multimodal dataset of 30,676 Olympiad-level problems from 47 countries and 17 languages, paired with benchmarks for problem solving, math-aware retrieval and retrieval-augmented solving. Even Gemini-3.1-Pro reaches 78.4% and GPT-5 69.3%, embedding models struggle to retrieve equivalent problems, and retrieval quality strongly affects RAG, where DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale gains up to 12%.

items.title: AI scientists produce results without reasoning scientifically
items.title_zh: AI 科学家能产出结果，却不按科学方式推理
items.summary: Evaluating LLM-based scientific agents across eight domains through more than 25,000 runs, the study finds the base model explains 41.4% of variance versus 1.5% for the scaffold, and that evidence is ignored in 68% of traces while refutation-driven belief revision occurs in 26%. The same patterns appear in workflow execution and hypothesis-driven inquiry and persist even with near-complete successful trajectories as context, so outcome-based evaluation cannot detect the failures.

items.title: ClawEnvKit: Automatic Environment Generation for Claw-Like Agents
items.title_zh: ClawEnvKit：面向 Claw 类智能体的自动环境生成
items.summary: ClawEnvKit is an autonomous pipeline that turns natural-language descriptions into verified agent environments through parsing, generation and validation modules, producing task specifications, tool interfaces and scoring configurations. It yields Auto-ClawEval, 1,040 environments across 24 categories at 13,800x lower cost than human curation, and across 4 model families and 8 harnesses harness engineering adds up to 15.7 points over a bare ReAct baseline with no model saturating the benchmark.

items.title: Characterizing AlphaEarth Embedding Geometry for Agentic Environmental Reasoning
items.title_zh: 刻画面向智能体环境推理的 AlphaEarth 嵌入几何
items.summary: The authors characterize the manifold geometry of Google AlphaEarth's 64-dimensional embeddings across 12.1 million continental US samples, finding an effective dimensionality of 13.3 and tangent spaces that rotate substantially. They build a nine-tool agentic system over a FAISS-indexed embedding database; retrieval dominates response quality (mean 3.79 versus 3.03 parametric-only), and geometric tools help Opus 4.6 but slightly hurt Sonnet 4.5.

items.title: LogosKG: Hardware-Optimized Scalable and Interpretable Knowledge Graph Retrieval
items.title_zh: LogosKG：硬件优化的可扩展可解释知识图谱检索
items.summary: LogosKG is a hardware-aligned framework for scalable, interpretable k-hop retrieval on large knowledge graphs, using degree-aware partitioning, cross-graph routing and on-demand caching. Experiments report efficiency gains over CPU and GPU baselines without loss of retrieval fidelity.

items.title: Dual-View Training for Instruction-Following Information Retrieval
items.title_zh: 面向指令遵循信息检索的双视角训练
items.summary: The authors propose polarity-reversal dual-view data synthesis: given a query, a compliant document and a hard negative, an LLM generates a complementary instruction under which the two documents swap relevance labels. On a 305M-parameter encoder this improves FollowIR performance by 45%, surpassing comparable or larger general-purpose embedding models.

items.title: Subgraph Concept Networks: Concept Levels in Graph Classification
items.title_zh: 子图概念网络：图分类中的概念层级
items.summary: The Subgraph Concept Network performs soft clustering on node concept embeddings to derive subgraph- and graph-level concepts, addressing the limitation that prior concept-based explanations cover only the node embedding space and are obscured by pooling. Results show competitive model accuracy while discovering meaningful concepts at multiple levels.

items.title: A multimodal and temporal foundation model for virtual patient representations at healthcare system scale
items.title_zh: 面向医疗系统规模虚拟患者表示的多模态时序基础模型
items.summary: Apollo is a multimodal temporal foundation model trained on 25 billion records from 7.2 million patients across three decades, 28 modalities and 12 specialties, learning a unified representation space for over 100,000 medical events plus images and clinical text. Across 322 prognosis and retrieval tasks on 1.4 million held-out patients it forecasts new disease onset up to five years ahead and supports multimodal medical search.

items.title: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview: Smarter, Sharper, Still Evolving
items.title_zh: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview：更聪明、更锐利，仍在进化
items.summary: Qwen previewed Qwen3.6-Max, with the platform listing capabilities spanning chat, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: Gradient-based Planning for World Models at Longer Horizons
items.title_zh: 面向更长时域世界模型的梯度规划
items.summary: GRASP is a gradient-based planner for learned world models that lifts trajectories into virtual states so optimization runs in parallel across time, adds stochasticity to state iterates for exploration, and reshapes gradients to give actions clean signals. The post argues these changes make long-horizon planning with large learned simulators more practical.

items.title: OpenClaw isn't fooling me. I remember MS-DOS
items.title_zh: OpenClaw 骗不了我，我还记得 MS-DOS
items.summary: A commentary compares today's AI agent security to MS-DOS, when any program could access the kernel and write anywhere on disk, and argues the fix is a different system design built on rings, virtual memory and access controls rather than a wrapper or a new shell.
